name: The Love Potion

faq.answer: Mistress Nagmara waits within the halls of Blackrock Depths.

aliases: what do you need for the love potion
faq.answer: She requires four sprigs of Gromsblood, ten Giant Silver Veins, and her own filled vial brought into the depths.
faq.q: What ingredients are needed for the potion?

aliases: where does the love potion quest happen
faq.answer: The brew must be delivered to Mistress Nagmara inside the fiery dwarven city of Blackrock Depths.

sections.body: Mistress Nagmara waits in the gloom of Blackrock Depths for the components of a potent draught. She seeks Gromsblood, Giant Silver Veins, and her filled vial delivered straight to her hands beneath the mountain. Bringing these strange reagents together will finish her brewing.
sections.title: Reagents for Mistress Nagmara

summary: Deep within Blackrock Depths, Mistress Nagmara seeks rare ingredients to brew a draught of passion. Gathering Gromsblood, Giant Silver Veins, and her filled vial will see the potion finished.
